title: Wayland: Parameter "ws" is null (minor error)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot version: 4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47]

### System information

OS: Arch Linux (Kernel 6.18.1-arch1-2)  Window Manager: cosmic-comp (Wayland)  GPU: AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (RADV CARRIZO)  Mesa: 25.3.1-arch1.2

### Issue description

The console is spammed with: ```ERROR: platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:1900 - Parameter "ws" is null.```

### Steps to reproduce

Launch Godot 4.6-beta2 on a Wayland compositor (cosmic-comp).

Perform basic scene tree operations:

    Create a Node.

    Remove a Node.

    Assign a mesh to a MeshInstance3D.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any project
